label: Slack: Await Action
description: Posts a Slack message with buttons and pauses the run until someone clicks one, then emits which button and who; use it for approvals. The message is then edited so it cannot be clicked twice. Needs the app's interactivity delivery (the shared app's interactivity URL, or your own app's Socket Mode).
